deploy-bot: Canary rollout: prompt-route v2 -> new-endpoint /api/prompt/v2 (10% traffic). Monitoring metrics: latency, 5xx rate.
kevin: Paging — got the page, jumping in.
oncall-bot: Pager duty alert: @kevin on call for incidents (sev2) — acknowledge with `ack`.
kevin: ack — looking now.
sam: Noticed an uptick in routing errors from canary shard 3 ~ 20:40 UTC. Logs show `KV_CACHE_MISS` + 502 from the new endpoint.
rachel: Customer CS queue showing a couple threads about failures in message composition, linking request ids 8c5f and 8c60. Marking customers impacted: internal beta orgs.
support-lead: Which flag controls rollback? name?
sam: Flag is `ff.prompt_routing.experimental_v2` in LaunchDarkly.
kevin: Reproduced locally: sending long context > 8k tokens -> endpoint returns 502 and runtime oom/gpu-copy error in logs.
sam: Aha — kernel selection path isn't picking the quantized kernel for long sequences. Possible model variant mismatch.
kevin: I'm going to flip the killswitch to stop routing to v2. Calling the flag kill now.
kevin: /ld toggle ff.prompt_routing.experimental_v2 off --env production --comment "emergency killswitch: canary 10% -> stop"
deploy-bot: LaunchDarkly: flag ff.prompt_routing.experimental_v2 set to OFF for production (actor: kevin).
oncall-bot: Incident annotation: killswitch activated by kevin at 5087654330.
sam: Confirming traffic drop to new-endpoint. Metrics: 5xx rate for v2 back to 0, overall latency normalized.
rachel: Sending customer note draft to support channel. CS notified impacted beta customers and offered rollback timeline + workaround (use stable endpoint).
support-lead: Good. Can we gather root cause logs and attach to the postmortem? Assign to sam + kevin.
sam: Will capture kernel selection traces, sequence length distribution, and model variant mapping.
kevin: I'll collect kube pod logs and dmesg/gpu errors, also add stack trace from runtime.
oncall-bot: Handoff: @kevin staying on call for next 30m for follow-up and RCA.
support-lead: If anything changes, reopen pager. Otherwise we can close active paging. Thanks all — :thumbsup:
_meta: generated: Redwood Inference synthetic realistic incident thread about feature flag killswitch activation for prompt routing new endpoint
